title: LEAVING THE VILLAGE, FROM HIGH ABOVE + THE SHADOW + PULL OUT TO SPACE
prompt:
20 seconds, 16:9. 3 SHOTS in one video, in this order, joined by hard cuts at the times given; each shot keeps its own camera, place and light; never blend two shots.

REFERENCES, each with a job:
@Image1: THE MOUNT, their ride: a manta-like sea creature about 4 m across the wings, a sea-green mottled back, a long thin whip tail, small calm dark eyes on the front edge, a soft lime-green glow on its underside. Strapped to its back is a hand-built seat of weathered driftwood lashed with green kelp rope, pale bone ribs for a backrest, seashells and small glowing seed-pod lamps tied along it, tufts of glowing green grass at the corners. Take nothing of the white background.
@Image2: THE VILLAGE: giant mangrove-like trees standing in glass-clear turquoise water with no land anywhere, long arching stilt roots, wooden houses lashed among the branches and grown over with glowing neon-green grass, ladders and rope bridges, a huge close moon in a bright blue-white sky. Take the whole place and its light from it.
@Image3: THE YOUNG ONE, a child of an amphibious alien people, about 1.1 m tall: smooth coral-pink skin with tiny glowing gold freckles, large round glossy dark eyes with an orange ring, a wide mouth, a mane of feathery external gills around the head in orange-gold, webbed three-fingered hands, webbed feet, a short flat tail fin, a woven kelp satchel on a strap across the chest. Face, body and colours only; take nothing of the white background.
@Image4: THE TURNING LIGHT, a colour reference only: the deep indigo of the water INSIDE the child's circle of light; nothing of its sky, its light or its composition.
@Image5: THE PLANET, the only reference: an ocean world with no land, split into two hemispheres, one bright blue-white with turquoise sea and white cloud, one purple-black under a storm with violet lightning, a sharp line between them, a moon half its size beside it in black space.

SHOT 1 of 3, from 0s to 6s: LEAVING THE VILLAGE, FROM HIGH ABOVE. Within this shot: one continuous take. A high aerial shot looking down for the whole shot, slowly rising; the camera never comes down to the riders; no cut inside this shot, no zoom.
FROM HIGH ABOVE, THE MOUNT LEAVES THE VILLAGE with three tiny riders on its back.
THE FRAME: Straight down from high above: THE MOUNT small in the lower middle of the frame, a long wake trailing back to the village of giant trees at the bottom edge; the rest of the frame is open glass-clear sea.
PARTICLES: sea spray glinting in the light, the wake sparkling.
WHAT HAPPENS:
[0s] From high above, THE MOUNT glides away from the village with three tiny riders on its seat.
[2s] The camera keeps rising; the village shrinks at the bottom of the frame.
[4s] Only open sea ahead, bright and calm, all the way to the horizon.
Sound in this shot: only the sounds the characters make themselves: silence; nobody speaks. No music, no ambient sound.
Colour grade, their daylight: bright blue-white, faint stars still visible in the bright sky, never orange, cool turquoise water, the neon-green grass as the one warm accent. Photographed, not rendered: fine film grain, gentle anamorphic softness at the edges.
Avoid in this shot: no dialogue, no close-up, no medium shot, no people standing, no faces, no black water, no dark line, no storm, no land, no boat.

SHOT 2 of 3, from 6s to 14s: THE SHADOW. Within this shot: one locked shot. Straight down from very high above; the camera never moves.
THE SHADOW. From very high: the mount is a tiny speck of light, and something enormous passes beneath.
THE FRAME: Top-down from very high: THE MOUNT a tiny speck with its tiny circle of light in the centre of a vast black sea; the sea surface flat and calm under the rain.
STATE: THE MOUNT, described here because no picture of it is attached after the crossing: a manta-like sea creature about 4 m across the wings, a sea-green mottled back, a long thin whip tail, a hand-built seat of weathered driftwood lashed with kelp rope, pale bone ribs for a backrest, seashells tied along it; nothing on THE MOUNT gives off any light. Their skin, the seat and the back of THE MOUNT are wet and glistening with rain.
THE LIGHT: Once THE YOUNG ONE is glowing, the only light in the whole frame comes from the child: a warm golden glow from the child's whole body, gill frills blazing gold. It lights a circle exactly 2 metres in radius around the child and nothing beyond it. Inside the circle the black water turns to the deep indigo water of the turning, and the riders and THE MOUNT are lit gold; outside the circle everything is pitch black. Nothing else in the frame gives off light.
PARTICLES: rain falling toward the flat water, a faint shimmer across the surface.
WHAT HAPPENS:
[6s] THE YOUNG ONE glows warm gold from the whole body, lighting the circle of water 2 metres around the child, indigo inside, pitch black outside. Seen from very high, THE MOUNT is a tiny glowing speck on a flat black sea in the rain.
[8s] Beneath it, deep down, an enormous dark shadow slides slowly past, hundreds of times bigger than THE MOUNT, covering most of the frame, its edges lost in the dark.
[10s] The tiny fish shadows around the speck of light scatter in every direction and vanish.
[12s] The shadow is gone. The flat sea is empty. Only the tiny speck of light remains.
Sound in this shot: only the sounds the characters make themselves: the faintest startled gasp; no words. No music, no ambient sound.
Colour grade, the dark with the child's light: pitch-black water in steady rain, the warm golden glow of THE YOUNG ONE the only light, deep indigo water inside its 2-metre circle, deep true blacks everywhere else. Photographed, not rendered: fine film grain.
Avoid in this shot: no words spoken by anyone, no talking, no shouted words, no voiceover, no camera move, no creature shape, no eye, no fin, no surfacing, no waves, only a shadow, no other light source.

SHOT 3 of 3, from 14s to 20s: PULL OUT TO SPACE. Within this shot: one continuous take. One continuous pull-out upward; no cut inside this shot, no dissolve.
THE LAST IMAGE. We leave them and see the whole world they live on.
THE FRAME: Ends on THE PLANET centred, its moon beside it.
WHAT HAPPENS:
[14s] From the black stormy sea the camera pulls back and rises, up through the storm clouds.
[16.5s] Out into space: the curve of the planet appears, then the whole globe.
[18.5s] THE PLANET hangs in black space, split between its bright half and its storm half, the moon beside it. Hold.
Sound in this shot: only the sounds the characters make themselves: silence. No music, no ambient sound.
Colour grade, the dark: pitch-black water and a purple-black storm, violet lightning as the key light, cyan and magenta glints, deep true blacks. Photographed, not rendered: fine film grain.
Avoid in this shot: no dialogue, no land, no continents, no rings around the planet, no second moon, no text.
